google_review_notes: No login required. Blood Sugar Log opens on the Log tab after a 3-card intro (Skip). Type a glucose value (mg/dL or mmol/L, exact 18.0156 conversion), pick the meal context, optionally add carbs, tags and a note, and Save reading. The result is coloured against target ranges the USER sets (Insights > Edit ranges; a neutral default applies until then). Insights shows time in range, charts, averages by time of day and by meal context, and an estimated A1C that is labelled 'Estimate', states the ADAG formula and appears only with at least 20 readings on 10 days in the last 90. Testing reminders (bell icon, Log tab) are weekly or on a set date. Doctor summary is plain text shared via the share sheet. Pro and Remove Ads are one-time in-app products (Settings > Purchases); Restore purchases is in the same section. All data stays on the device. HEALTH APPS DECLARATION: the app is a personal glucose logbook. It is not a medical device, gives no diagnosis, treatment, dosing or insulin advice and has no insulin or dose calculator; onboarding, the Log tab, Settings and the listing say so and tell users to talk to their care team. Readings far outside the user's own limits show a note to contact the care team or local emergency number. No health data leaves the device (Data Safety: no health data collected).
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test in-app purchases open Settings (gear, top right) > Purchases: Go Pro (pro_lifetime) or Remove ads (remove_ads); Restore purchases is in the same section. The app is a glucose logbook, not a medical device: no diagnosis, no dosing or insulin advice, ranges are set by the user, the A1C figure is labelled as an estimate with its formula. All data stays on device. No demo account needed.
